headline: CAMPFIRE lit up the demos shelf
lede: A night campfire you can believe: volumetric flame, cast light, embers and crackle — one self-contained WebGL2 file, live at /retrogames/demos/campfire — plus a red-main freeze diagnosed and broken along the way.

notes.text: DEMO #670 CAMPFIRE shipped (fea79f8): raymarched ridged-fBm flame with blackbody emission, stone-ring + log tipi catching a flickering point light with soft shadows, additive embers, wispy smoke, starfield, bloom, synthesized crackle. 18-gate campfirecheck harness, mutant-proven.

Red-main freeze (#601) broken: the nightly failure was a Gauntlet #505 mutant surviving because the pace gate (2.0) couldn't tell heading-prediction (worst gap 0.18) from its mutant (1.05). Tightened to 0.5 (#693), nightly re-ran green, freeze lifted.
A debug probe that fails to compile lies to you in perfect black — verify the probe before believing it (two wasted frames on a 3-arg vec4 constructor under ANGLE).

Prod caveat filed as #696: the host proxy serves /retrogames/demos/ from a ~2.7-day cache, so demo cards (CAMPFIRE/SHORE/OCEAN) stay invisible on the live index even though the demos themselves proxy fresh.
